notes: Each scenario alternates first seat across 100 pairs (200 games).
The current modular alpha implements only the experimental legalRecolor skill; these are engineering-policy results, not final balance claims.
firstPolicyWins identifies levelFirst, independent of seat.

findings.safety: All 800 games completed with zero rejected actions and zero illegal-color terminals.
findings.easyNormalSeparation: Normal won 169/200 against easy; the first-move rate was 52.5%.
findings.normalHardSeparation: Hard won only 102/200 against normal; this is not sufficient evidence of a meaningful strength separation.
findings.firstMoveRange: Observed first-move win rates ranged from 52.0% to 56.5% across these scenarios.
findings.legalRecolorOpportunity: Normal mirror used 1.98 legalRecolor cards per game with the card enabled; disabling it shortened mean game length from 30.79 to 26.6 actions.
findings.nextAction: Keep current rules unchanged; improve hard evaluation and repeat paired gates after profile/loadout and remaining skill handlers are integrated.

hardPolicyV2FollowUp.change: Hard ranks CREATE intents by distinct adjacent public colors before contact count and reserves experimental legal recolor for public regions of degree two or greater.
hardPolicyV2FollowUp.interpretation: The public-only evaluator now produces a reproducible strength separation on two independent seed blocks without changing game rules. Re-run after full card/profile integration before final tuning.
